title: ContactCard/copy args
description: Arguments for ContactCard/copy (RFC 9610 §6.6). Copies contact cards between accounts.

fromAccountId.description: The account to copy contact cards from.

ifFromInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard on the source ContactCard state.

accountId.description: The account to copy contact cards into.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard on the destination ContactCard state.

create.description: Map of client-assigned creation ids to objects describing the copy.

id.description: The id of the ContactCard in the source account.

addressBookId.description: The AddressBook to place the copy in.

onSuccessDestroyOriginal.description: If true, destroy original contact cards on success. Default: false.

destroyFromIfInState.description: Guard on source state when destroying originals.
